about_the_game:
The Perfect Bowl is a cozy and heartfelt ramen arrangement visual novel about dealing with grief, following Jim Wada, the new owner of his family’s ramen business. Journey with him as he copes with his father’s illness and helps his customers find comfort in ramen. Perhaps to heal himself along the way.

Emotionally Honest Story about Grief

Some end up back to where they started with a different outlook in life. Some come out stronger, finding renewed purpose. Others leave their old life entirely. Immerse yourself as Jim Wada and find out how he comes out of this ordeal.

Customized Ramen for your Customers

Things work a little different around here. There are no menus for customers to choose from. Instead they strike up a conversation and let Jim work his ramen magic. 

Quirky Cast of Characters

You're bound to meet some very interesting people working at a wondering ramen cart. Meet the array of quirky characters who seem to be in dire need of some comforting ramen. Uncover their stories and their relationship with ramen.

Beautiful & Cozy

Immerse yourself into this cozy environment with a vibe that melts away your walls and readies your soul for a heartfelt story.
